ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe areas and 35% low-intensity black/dark grey pixels located primarily along the trailing edges and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions on both lobes. High-frequency black mottling and circular white-on-black rosette patterns are distributed throughout. A thick, irregular dark boundary follows the trailing edge, with increased dark pixel density near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 82 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the continuous trailing edge boundary. Pixel amplitude of peaks and valleys ranges from 4 to 18 pixels, with the highest complexity located at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve; trailing edges demonstrate a sigmoidal trajectory, curving concavely from the median notch before transitioning to a convex sweep toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (annular rings and solid discs) corresponding to barnacle colonization. Significant clusters are located at the distal tips and scattered across the central-right ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct linear pixel disruptions observed on the lower central-left lobe (diagonal orientation) and several thin vertical scratches on the mid-right lobe, characterized by high-intensity lines breaking dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across both lobes; numerous fine linear rake marks or scratches are visible in the lower pigmented sections near the center.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-density leopard-like spotting pattern created by overlapping natural pigmentation and secondary rosette scarring across the entirety of both lobes.
